## IT AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract)
URL: https://www.byteflow.ae/it-amc-services-dubai

IT AMC stands for Information Technology Annual Maintenance Contract: an agreement for ongoing support, maintenance and management of a business's computers, servers, networks, Microsoft 365 and connected office equipment.

### Published pricing (per user, per month, excluding 5% VAT)
- Essential (Remote IT Support): AED 40. For smaller teams that mainly need remote help.
- Standard (Remote and On-Site IT Support): AED 70. Everything in Essential plus on-site visits, server and network management.
- Complete (Fully Managed IT Support): AED 110. Everything in Standard plus priority support and eligible website/SEO technical monitoring.
- Example: a 10-person office on Essential pays AED 400 per month before VAT.
- Final fee depends on users, devices, servers, locations and support hours.

### Service levels
- Remote support response: within 30 minutes of a ticket.
- On-site response: within 2 hours across Dubai, with no premium zones.
- Unlimited remote assistance for covered incidents; call volume does not change the price.
- 24/7 monitoring of eligible systems. The staffed helpdesk runs Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM.
- Monthly and annual contract options; terms are confirmed in the proposal before signing.

### Included vs quoted separately
- Included: remote and on-site support (per plan), patching, antivirus management, MFA and access reviews, Microsoft 365 administration, printer and scanner troubleshooting.
- Quoted separately: hardware and parts, advanced EDR and threat monitoring, penetration testing, backup licences and storage, website redesigns and content production.

### Common questions
- AMC vs break-fix: break-fix means paying per job when something fails; an AMC provides ongoing monitoring, maintenance and support under one agreement.
- Comprehensive vs non-comprehensive AMC: non-comprehensive covers labour with parts charged separately; comprehensive may include specified replacements.
- Switching providers: Byteflow can plan a structured transition and audit the existing setup. Check the notice period in the current contract first.

## Cyber Security
URL: https://www.byteflow.ae/cyber-security

Layered protection: next-generation firewalls, endpoint detection and response (EDR), email security, network monitoring and staff phishing training.

- Most common threats to Dubai businesses: phishing and business email compromise.
- Ransomware response: EDR isolates an infected device within seconds; data is restored from clean backups, typically within 2 to 4 hours.
- Serious incidents: on-site within 2 hours. Byteflow follows contain, preserve evidence, eradicate, restore, and report.
- Compliance: aligns controls with UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on Personal Data Protection, NESA guidelines and sector requirements.
- No in-house security team needed; Byteflow acts as the outsourced security team.

---

## Data Backup and Recovery
URL: https://www.byteflow.ae/data-backup-recovery

- Hourly automated backups with immutable (ransomware-proof) storage.
- Backups stored in UAE data centres by default, encrypted with AES-256 at rest and in transit.
- Microsoft 365 backup covers mailboxes, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive. Microsoft itself does not protect against deletion or ransomware.
- Restore after ransomware: most clients operational within 2 to 4 hours. Individual files: minutes.
- Bare-metal server recovery: most clients back up within 4 hours of hardware failure.
- Test restores run quarterly, with reports provided.

---

## Cloud Services (Microsoft 365 and Azure)
URL: https://www.byteflow.ae/cloud-services-dubai

- Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace setup, migration and management; Azure servers; SharePoint and Teams; hybrid cloud.
- Migration time: 2 to 3 days for up to 25 users; 1 to 2 weeks (phased) for 50 to 200 users.
- Zero email loss approach: old and new systems run in parallel until cutover. 200+ migrations completed.
- Recommended plan for most small businesses: Microsoft 365 Business Standard.
- Regulated industries: configurations that meet UAE data residency and sector compliance (e.g. ADHICS for healthcare).
- Ongoing Microsoft 365 administration is included in IT AMC contracts.

## System Integration
URL: https://www.byteflow.ae/system-integration

- Network design, structured cabling, servers, Wi-Fi, CCTV, access control, VoIP and multi-site connectivity.
- A 20 to 50 user office network takes 1 to 3 days, done off-hours where possible.
- Brands: Cisco, Ubiquiti, HPE Aruba, Fortinet, Hikvision and others; existing hardware can be kept if fit for purpose.
- Multi-emirate offices connected with site-to-site VPN and SD-WAN.

## Guides on IT costs in Dubai

- IT support cost for small offices: basic remote support from around AED 500 per month; plans with on-site visits around AED 1,500+. https://www.byteflow.ae/it-support-cost-dubai
- An in-house IT employee costs roughly AED 5,000 per month in salary alone, plus visa, insurance and gratuity. https://www.byteflow.ae/outsourced-vs-in-house-it-support-dubai
- IT AMC vs managed IT services: an AMC maintains and repairs equipment for a fixed fee; managed IT proactively monitors, secures and manages the whole environment. https://www.byteflow.ae/it-amc-vs-managed-it-services-dubai
- What IT AMC is and what it covers: https://www.byteflow.ae/what-is-it-amc-dubai
- New office IT setup: plan 6 to 8 weeks before move-in; involve the IT partner before fit-out starts. https://www.byteflow.ae/new-office-it-setup-dubai
- UAE VAT on IT services is 5%.
